map.采购部门制定补货策略时，用 EOQ 平衡订货成本与持有成本，确定每次最优订货量。: When the purchasing department sets a replenishment strategy, it uses EOQ to balance ordering cost against holding cost and determine the optimal quantity per order.
map.面对需求波动与不确定提前期，用安全库存与再订货点 ROP 设定补货触发线，防止缺: Facing demand fluctuation and uncertain lead times, use safety stock and the reorder point ROP to set the replenishment trigger line and prevent line stoppages from material shortages.

map.5、服务水平 95%（Z=1.65）。EOQ = √(2×12000×50÷2): standard deviation 5, service level 95% (Z = 1.65). EOQ = √(2 × 12000 × 50 ÷ 2) ≈ 775 units; annual orders 12000 ÷ 775 ≈ 15.5 times (a cycle of about 24 days); average inventory ≈ 387 units; safety stock = 1.65 × 5 × √7 ≈ 22 units; reorder point ROP = 33 × 7 + 22 ≈ 253 units; minimum total inventory cost ≈ √(2 × 12000 × 50 × 2) ≈ 1549 CNY.
map.EOQ 越大越好还是越小越好？: Is a larger or a smaller EOQ better?
map.EOQ 是总成本最低点：订货量过大增加持有成本，过小增加订货频次与订货成本。EO: EOQ is the point of lowest total cost: too large an order quantity raises holding cost, while too small a quantity raises order frequency and ordering cost. The EOQ formula √(2DS/H) already balances the two, and in practice safety stock must be added on top to absorb fluctuation.
map.再订货点 ROP 怎么用？: How is the reorder point ROP used?
map.库存降到 ROP（日均需求×提前期 + 安全库存）时即触发订货，确保提前期内不断: When inventory falls to the ROP (average daily demand × lead time + safety stock), an order is triggered, ensuring no stockout during the lead time. The higher the service level (larger Z) and the greater the demand fluctuation, the higher the safety stock and the ROP.
